capability: Launcher-pending fence for automatic managed-version recovery
searchEvidence: ReloadDurableCurrentWithoutLockAsync is the sole automatic recovery entry and invokes ReconcilePendingMutationAsync before returning a snapshot.
A caller may initialize while Bootstrap has released the OS lease for launcher READY, so this recovery path must inspect the same logical launcher fence before mutating.
semanticOwner: VersionManagement Application durable reload/recovery path using the shared launcher mutation-fence port
terminalContract: Automatic recovery never mutates app state or filesystem while a launcher transaction is pending or its fence cannot be read; the snapshot fails closed as state unavailable and the exact pending app mutation remains durable for a later safe recovery.

designReview.evidence: ADR 0056 admission requires every app-state mutator, including recovery after process-boundary lease release, to honor the logical launcher fence.
